notes: The Parcoursup page is for French and European Bac holders; foreign-diploma applicants apply via Etudes en France / Campus France, so the application deadline is not extracted. The tuition fee of 178 euros per year on the page applies to EU students; the differentiated fee for non-EU students (2,902 to 3,950 euros per year depending on cycle) comes from an institution-wide page (maroc.campusfrance.org), not the programme page, so it is not stated as a fact for this programme. A document list is given only for the French national platform Parcoursup (CV); it may not exactly match the Campus France document list for non-EU applicants.
